technical.summary: Short-term bullish momentum with golden cross and three white soldiers, but lack of trend confirmation (low ADX), negative CMF, and price below 200-SMA limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: IFF shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk with 88 days to next report.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (13/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (2 sales vs 1 purchase, all dated 135+ days ago) and absent recent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (430.88), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinationals; CPI event just occurred; 88-day earnings window provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable for risk assets.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross (EMA 9/21) + three white soldiers pattern with positive short-term momentum and extreme fear sentiment (13/100) create a contrarian entry opportunity near support at 111.68.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), price remains below 200-SMA and 50-SMA, CMF is negative, ADX shows no trend confirmation, and fundamental/sentiment scores are critically weak (3/10 each) with high earnings risk in 88 days.
